title: build(deps): bump chart.js from 4.5.1 to 4.6.1
intent: Runtime currency, no advisory. chart.js 4.5.1 -> 4.6.1 is a MINOR bump of a shipped runtime dependency. 4.6.0: corrected spacing in pie/doughnut/polarArea (#12238), scale title stroke option (#12130), filler fill no longer extends past the line with offset:true + index-scale min/max (#12283), clearStacks early-exit fix (#12155), integer canvas dimensions (#12142), types allow scriptable/indexed grid tick widths (#12321). 4.6.1 is a trusted-publishing re-release of 4.6.0 (#12355). GitHub's advisory API returns 0 advisories for chart.js@4.5.1 and @4.6.1.
behavior_change: Small, rendering-level, on shipped routes. Lockfile vs merge base 02032884: 400 entries before and after, ZERO added, ZERO removed, exactly ONE node_modules entry changed: chart.js 4.5.1 -> 4.6.1 (version, resolved, integrity; its dependency map unchanged). Root differs only in dependencies['chart.js'] ^4.5.1 -> ^4.6.1. Shipped consumers: tools/audio_analyzer/renderers (SpectrumChartRenderer.vue, useSpectrumChartRender/State, useTransferFunctionChart, useWsiCurveChart), views/calculators/acoustics/SoundholeCalculator.vue, views/multi_run_comparison/composables/useMultiRunComparisonChart.ts. A/B vite build: 199 vs 199 files; after normalising Vite's content hashes, exactly ONE chunk differs in content -- assets/chart-*.js, 166172 -> 166560 bytes; every other file differs only by the renamed chunk reference. Observable effects possible: canvas backing-store dimensions are now rounded to integers (sub-pixel sharpness/size of charts on fractional devicePixelRatio), and filled line datasets on offset index scales no longer overdraw. Not covered by automated tests: the client test environment (happy-dom) has no canvas, and no spec renders a Chart instance -- a manual look at one spectrum chart and the soundhole calculator chart is the remaining check.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json moves dependencies['chart.js'] from ^4.5.1 to ^4.6.1. package-lock.json resolves chart.js 4.5.1 -> 4.6.1 and updates the root range. Dependabot's incidental peer-flag churn on 16 unchanged-version entries was reverted so nothing else moves.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency; this manifest exists because Dependabot cannot author one (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001). No existing manifest covers this diff, and borrowing one is what the rule refuses -- PR #296's silent zod 4 -> 3 revert is why.

Integrity of every moved entry == `npm view <pkg>@<ver> dist.integrity`; published via GitHub Actions OIDC with SLSA provenance; no preinstall/install/postinstall scripts.

None of them instantiate Chart -- recorded as a coverage gap, not as evidence of rendering parity.
